'''''The Acolyte: The Crystal Crown''''' is a ''[[Star Wars]]'' young-adult novel written by [[Tessa Gratton]] was published by [[Random House]]'s [[Disney–Lucasfilm Press]] imprint on [[July 29]], [[2025]]. The [[The Acolyte: The Crystal Crown (audiobook)|audio version]] was released on [[October 28]], [[2025]].
